summary: Implements CLI command hooks for Cursor integration, specifically handling stop events and managing agent hook configuration.
responsibilities: Define CLI commands for Cursor integration lifecycle management.
Validate input schema for Cursor stop hook payloads.
Process Cursor stop hook payloads via stdin and initiate pings to the instrumentation backend.
Integrate core command groups for configuring agent-specific hooks.
